headline: SSC results: Pass rate falls to 62.25% as GPA-5 holders decline
summary: Over 690,000 students failed the exams, while girls outperformed boys in both pass rates and GPA-5 achievements.
details: The average pass rate across 11 education boards for the SSC and equivalent exams has fallen to 62.25%. A total of 116,676 students achieved GPA-5, marking a decline in high achievers for the fourth consecutive year.

Approximately 690,608 students failed to clear the exams. In a stark contrast, 669 institutions recorded a 100% pass rate, while 312 institutions saw zero students pass—an increase of 178 schools compared to last year.
Gender-based performance shows that girls outperformed boys in both the overall pass rate and the number of GPA-5 holders. Dhaka board emerged as the top performer in terms of GPA-5 achievers.
The Madrasa Board recorded the lowest pass rate at 55.49%, while the Technical Board's pass rate stood at 58.20%. In the humanities group, over half of the students were unable to clear the exams.

Concerns have been raised over English proficiency, as the pass rate for English was below 75% in 7 out of 9 boards. The overall pass rate for the 9 general education boards was 64.05%, down from 68.04% last year.
caption:
Pass rates are down and GPA-5 holders have declined for the fourth year in a row. Over 690,000 students failed the SSC exams.

The average pass rate across 11 education boards for the SSC and equivalent exams has fallen to 62.25%. A total of 116,676 students achieved GPA-5, marking a decline in high achievers for the fourth consecutive year.

Approximately 690,608 students failed to clear the exams. In a stark contrast, 669 institutions recorded a 100% pass rate, while 312 institutions saw zero students pass—an increase of 178 schools compared to last year.

Gender-based performance shows that girls outperformed boys in both the overall pass rate and the number of GPA-5 holders. Dhaka board emerged as the top performer in terms of GPA-5 achievers.

The Madrasa Board recorded the lowest pass rate at 55.49%, while the Technical Board's pass rate stood at 58.20%. In the humanities group, over half of the students were unable to clear the exams.

Concerns have been raised over English proficiency, as the pass rate for English was below 75% in 7 out of 9 boards. The overall pass rate for the 9 general education boards was 64.05%, down from 68.04% last year.

headline: 16 Bangladeshis killed in Saudi factory fire
summary: A devastating fire at a sofa factory in Riyadh's Musa Industrial Area killed 16 Bangladeshi workers on the spot.
details: At least 16 Bangladeshi nationals were killed in a devastating fire at a sofa factory in the Musa Industrial Area of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
The fire broke out around 2:00 pm yesterday, and according to the Ministry of Expatriates’ Welfare and Overseas Employment, all 16 victims died on the spot.
Of the deceased, 13 were from Naogaon, two were from Natore, and one was from Rajshahi.
The Bangladesh Embassy in Riyadh is in close contact with Saudi authorities to identify the victims and facilitate the return of their bodies to Bangladesh.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has confirmed that necessary arrangements are being made to repatriate the remains of the deceased workers.
caption:
16 Bangladeshi workers killed on the spot in a devastating sofa factory fire in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

The fire broke out around 2:00 pm yesterday, and according to the Ministry of Expatriates’ Welfare and Overseas Employment, all 16 victims died on the spot.

Of the deceased, 13 were from Naogaon, two were from Natore, and one was from Rajshahi.

The Bangladesh Embassy in Riyadh is in close contact with Saudi authorities to identify the victims and facilitate the return of their bodies to Bangladesh.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has confirmed that necessary arrangements are being made to repatriate the remains of the deceased workers.
